main_text.l: cturam,constat ex Plinio libr.8 cap.17. Sed quis hæc solo calore, quæ vix igne domari possunt, in corporibus animalium confici posse putabit? Vix id, opinor, quispiam credet, nisi congenitæ torius membrorum sub-stantiæ coquendi istam virtutem ac proprietatem attribuerit.

Verum, vt ad coruos nostros reuertamur, sciendum, carnes eorum mirè conducere iis, qui natura temperamentum compaginemque corporis habent laxiorem, hoc est, minus solidam firmamque ac compactam, hu-midumque radicale nimis fluxile: ob-sucum inquam incrassantem ac consolidantem, qui coruorum carnibus ineft, prodest coruis vesci, iis, qui se natura sentiunt minus vegetos, viriumque dissolutarum. Vnde evi-dentissimè vitæ longioris breuiorisque causam in-notescere diligens lector facilè per-spexerit.
Assi autem in cibis præstant elixis, & hieme quoque quam æstate salubriores sunt, per æstatem enim in autumnum morbo cor-uos conflictari Plinius autor est, libr. 29. cap.3.
Cæterum inauspicatissimos eos esse omnium consensu traditur, sed tum maximè cum vocem glutiunt, velut strangulati, tunc enim pessima eorum significatio est.

page.notes: Marginal notes were read from the right margin. "Cornua" (beside "Verum") is uncertain. The note "caro, quibus..." is cut across lines and "nenia?" is doubtful. "Vitæ longioris ac breuiorum", "causa ue-rissima detegitur" and "Assi elixa", "salubria", "rea." are small and only partly legible, so they are omitted here. The word "cturam" at the page top is a fragment of the previous line. Printing irregularities such as "libr.8", "cap.17" and "torius" are copied as printed. The printed "Plinius" citation "libr. 29. cap.3." is set in the line, not as a note.
